title: MobArmyWars
description: MobArmyWars is a server-side PvE battle plugin for Paper servers, inspired by BastiGHG's MobArmyBattle. Two teams collect gear, resources and mobs, build their own mob waves and send them into an automatic arena battle against the enemy team.
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62d1921ad1051dc56a1b97eda0651ed322a1f148.jpeg) # 🛡️ MobArmyWars **MobArmyWars** is a server-side PvE battle plugin for **Paper servers**, inspired by the German YouTuber **BastiGHG's MobArmyBattle**. The game is played by two teams. During the preparation phase, players collect equipment, resources and mobs by defeating them. After that, each team configures up to **three mob waves** using the mobs they collected. These waves are then sent into an automatic arena battle against the enemy team. The team that defeats the opposing mob army first wins. ## 🧩 Game Flow MobArmyWars is played by two teams: **Red** and **Blue**. At the start of the game, both teams are sent into separate but identical worlds. During the preparation phase, each team collects equipment, resources and mobs. Mobs are collected by defeating monsters. Once the preparation time is over, all players are teleported into a protected area. There, each team can distribute all collected mobs into up to **three attack waves**. After the wave setup is complete, both teams enter the arena. Each team then fights against the mob waves created by the opposing team. The team that defeats the enemy mob army first wins the game.

![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a2610c4ffe3490cce3a2fec352040c3ec192c8b.jpeg)

## ⭐ Extra Features - Separate lobby, team, Nether and arena worlds - Server-side world creation and reset systems - Team backpacks for shared item storage - Optional block randomizer - Chest randomizer - Resume system for continuing events - Configurable world settings, including difficulty - Optional arena monster compass - GUI-based settings and wave configuration - Custom mob spawn order based on click order - Team equipment selection - German in-game messages and GUIs ## ⚙️ Compatibility This is a **server-side Paper plugin**. It is not a client mod and does not belong in the `mods` folder. - Latest version requires **Paper 26.2** - Latest version requires **Java 25** - Not compatible with pure Spigot/Bukkit - In-game language: **German**

![GUI 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad2ee02dfe6922e99cdb8197fbcd99ead3c33aac.jpeg) ![GUI 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1efa48c14bfa6effa62680a93c2bb3df3eb6cc5d.jpeg)

## ⌨️ Commands ```text /optionen /team join rot /team join blau /team leave /mobstatus /arenasummary /resume mobarmy /mobarmy resume /setphase /reset ``` ## 👥 Recommended For MobArmyWars is designed for: - Minecraft events - PvE minigame servers - Private server battles - Content creators and community challenges - Team-based survival and strategy gameplay ## 🚧 Planned Features - Additional arenas - English in-game language support Planned features may change during development.
